div.head: Ine 48
div.ab: XCII. Gif hwylc mon biþ witeðeow niwan geþeowad, ⁊ hine mon betyhð, þæt he hæbbe ær geþeofad, ær hine mon geþeowode, þonne ah se tiond ane swingelan æt him: bedrife hine to swingum be his ceape.
XCII. Gif hwelc mon bið witeðeow niwan geðeowad, ⁊ hine mon betyhð, þæt he hæbbe ǽr geðiefed, ær hine mon geðeowode, þonne ah se teond ane swingellan æt him: bedrife hine to swingum be his ceape.

Si quis sit wytaseruus nouiter effectus (propter forisfactum nouiter inseruierit), et accusetur, quod furtum fecerit, antequam in seruitutem transierit, tunc habeat compellens uerberationem unam in eo: perducat eum ad uerbera secundum captale suum.
{XCII} Gif hwelc mon bið witeðeow niwan geðeowad, ⁊ hine mon betyhð, þæt he hæbbe ǽr geðiefed,ær hine mon geðeowode, þonne ah se teond ana swingellan æt him: bedrife hine to swingum be his ceape.

If someone has been newly reduced to the position of penal slave, and he is accused of having committed theft before he was made a slave, then the accuser has [the right] to flog him once. He shall compel him to lashings by [an oath in] the amount of his [stolen] property.

If any man, who has recently been reduced to penal slavery, is accused of having committed theft before he was reduced to slavery, the accuser shall have the right to scourge him once; he shall compel him to submit to a scourging by [an oath equivalent to the value of] the goods [stolen from him]

If any man is a newly enslaved penal slave, and he is accused of having stolen before he was enslaved, the accuser then has the right to give him one flogging; he can compel him to the flogging by [an oath of the amount of the stolen] goods.

Wenn irgendwer neuerdings verknechteter Strafknecht ist, und man ihn bezichtigt, dass er bereits, bevor er verknechtet wurde, gestohlen habe, dann hat der Kläger [das Recht,] einmalige Geisselung an ihm [zu vollziehen]: er zwinge ihn zur [Erleidung der] Prügelstrafe [durch Klageeid] in Höhe seines [gestohlenen] Werthes.

If anyone has recently been enslaved as a penalty-slave, and he is accused of having stolen before he was enslaved, then the plaintiff has [the right to inflict] one flogging on him: let him drive him to [suffer] the flogging [by an oath of accusation] to the amount of his [stolen] property.
